headline: From power stations to corporate HR: Panigrahi becomes ED – HR at NTPC
summary: NTPC has appointed 36-year company veteran Surya Narayan Panigrahi as Executive Director – HR, effective June 8, 2026. Panigrahi's extensive career at the power producer spans power station assignments, corporate digital transformations such as SAP ERP implementation, and regional HR leadership across Northern and Southern India. In his new role, he will leverage his broad functional and operational experience to oversee NTPC's enterprise-wide human resources.

headline: After Asia-wide roles, Kripa Krishnamoorthy takes charge of HR for Visa’s INSA market
summary: Visa has appointed seasoned HR executive Kripa Krishnamoorthy as its Head of HR for the India and South Asia (INSA) market. She brings over two decades of human resources leadership experience across financial services, consumer goods, and luxury retail, having previously held senior roles at organizations such as Synchrony, Citi, and Marico. In her new role, Krishnamoorthy transitions from regional, Asia-wide talent strategies back to a market-focused mandate.

headline: BMW to cut 20% of senior management roles by 2027 as AI reshapes organisation
summary: BMW AG plans to reduce its senior management positions by 20% by mid-2027 as part of a broader corporate restructuring to streamline operations. The German automaker will integrate artificial intelligence and consolidate divisions under a voluntary buyout program to accelerate decision-making and boost efficiency. This effort follows a larger initiative to cut up to 8,000 white-collar positions across its global workforce.

headline: Google employees question Gemini 4’s real-world performance despite strong benchmarks
summary: Google is experiencing internal debate over the real-world performance of its new Gemini 4 AI model, particularly regarding practical coding tasks despite strong benchmark scores. While some employees worry the model is over-optimized for standardized tests compared to rivals like OpenAI and Anthropic, others and company leadership maintain it is at the industry frontier. The divide highlights a broader discussion in the tech sector on evaluating AI capabilities through standardized benchmarks versus practical applications.

headline: Zypp Electric grants Rs 11 crore in ESOPs to over 250 employees
summary: EV logistics startup Zypp Electric has granted Rs 11 crore in ESOPs to over 250 employees, covering 22% of its workforce as it prepares for a potential IPO. The rollout coincides with strong operational growth, including an 88% year-on-year revenue increase in Q1 and an improvement in EBITDA margin to 10%. The company plans to expand its electric vehicle fleet from 30,000 to 100,000 across 20 cities by FY28.

headline: Canada tightens rules on foreign worker sponsorship
summary: Canada has introduced stricter rules under its Temporary Foreign Worker Programme, allowing only the entity that directly manages an employee to apply for a Labour Market Impact Assessment (LMIA). This change effectively ends the use of staffing agencies and Employers of Record to sponsor foreign workers on behalf of third-party businesses. Consequently, HR leaders must ensure direct employer sponsorship and compliance before seeking new permits or renewals.

headline: From HR operations to COO: Gautami Vinayan joins Utsav Group of Companies
summary: Gautami Vinayan has joined Utsav Group of Companies as Chief Operating Officer and HR, combining her extensive background in people management and operational execution. She previously held human resources and operational roles at organizations including Bennett Coleman & Co., Sodexo, and Compass Group. In her new dual role, Vinayan will drive workforce priorities and business strategy across Utsav Group's diversified business sectors.

headline: Case-in-Point: The employee who doesn’t want to become a manager
summary: HR leadership at Meridian Software is re-evaluating its career progression model after top-performing engineer Meera Pillai repeatedly declined promotions into people management. While the company traditionally views team leadership as the default path for high-potential talent, Pillai seeks advancement through deep technical specialization rather than administrative oversight. The case highlights the challenge organizations face in designing dual-career ladders that properly reward and retain senior specialist talent without forcing them into management.

headline: Mahesh Muralidhar Pai to take charge as MD & CEO, South Indian Bank
summary: South Indian Bank has appointed Mahesh Muralidhar Pai as its new Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer, effective October 1, 2026. Pai brings nearly 30 years of banking experience from Canara Bank, where he recently served as Chief General Manager leading enterprise digital transformation. In his new role, he aims to focus on technology-led execution, disciplined growth, and deepening customer relationships.

headline: Is Apple’s new CEO planning workforce cuts?
summary: Apple's new CEO, John Ternus, is preparing targeted layoffs and project cancellations to streamline operations amid mounting financial pressures. Squeezed by a global memory chip shortage and declining quarterly services revenue, the company aims to protect profitability and reallocate resources to higher-growth priorities. The strategy highlights how external market forces and margin pressures are increasingly shaping talent management in the tech industry.

headline: herSTORY: Sonal Jain, Global Chief HR & Transformation Officer, EPL
summary: Sonal Jain, Global Chief HR & Transformation Officer at EPL, reflects on her leadership evolution from overcoming internal self-doubt to prioritizing fairness, courage, and value creation over being liked. She emphasizes that successful organizational transformation requires clear communication, robust governance, and aligning teams around a shared purpose. Ultimately, Jain argues that future readiness depends on developing workforce learning agility and adaptability alongside rapid technological changes.

headline: Vishal Upadhyay moves up the HR leadership ranks at Waree Group
summary: Waree Group has promoted Vishal Upadhyay to Vice President of Human Resources after a 12-year tenure with the Indian renewable energy company. Having joined as an assistant manager in 2014, Upadhyay has steadily advanced through leadership positions while managing HR operations across solar and lithium-ion manufacturing sectors. In his new role, he will drive the company's people agenda and talent development frameworks as Waree continues its expansion.

headline: HCLTech offers Rs 18 lakh starting salary as it steps up ‘Elite Engineer’ hiring
summary: HCLTech is adopting a skills-based campus hiring strategy for its upcoming fresher intake, offering starting salaries ranging from Rs 4.5 lakh to Rs 18 lakh per year. The top pay tier targets an expanded 'Elite Engineer' cadre from premier institutes like IITs and NITs for specialized roles in AI, semiconductors, and robotics. Other graduates hired through partner colleges will be placed into tiered salary bands up to Rs 10 lakh based on technical evaluations.

headline: Jon Cook to step down as VML Global CEO, Eric Campbell to succeed him
summary: Jon Cook will step down as Global CEO of VML and CEO of WPP Creative in March 2027 after a 30-year tenure with the organization. Eric Campbell, currently serving as CEO of VML and WPP Creative in North America, will succeed Cook as VML's Global CEO while retaining his North American leadership position. Cook and Campbell will collaborate immediately to execute a seamless transition of global responsibilities over the coming months.

headline: Ray-Ban announces Ranveer Singh as brand ambassador for India
summary: Ray-Ban has appointed actor Ranveer Singh as its first brand ambassador for India, covering both its core eyewear collection and Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses. The strategic partnership aims to deepen the brand's market presence in India by combining classic fashion heritage with Meta's AI-driven wearable technology. A new integrated marketing campaign featuring Singh will highlight the fusion of personal style and smart features.
